Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# Workflow derived from https://github.com/r-lib/actions/tree/v2/examples
# Need help debugging build failures? Start at https://github.com/r-lib/actions#where-to-find-help
on:
  # build dev site on merged pushes
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  # build full site on releases
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

name: pkgdown.yaml

jobs:
  pkgdown:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Only restrict concurrency for non-PR jobs
    concurrency:
      group: pkgdown-${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.run_id }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    env:
      GITHUB_PAT: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      NOT_CRAN: true
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install pngquant
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y pngquant

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-pandoc@v2

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          use-public-rspm: true
          extra-repositories: |
            https://community.r-multiverse.org
            https://stan-dev.r-universe.dev

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@v2
        with:
          extra-packages: |
            any::pkgdown
            local::.
            stan-dev/pkgdown-config
            any::BH
            any::RcppEigen

      - name: Install CmdStan
        run: Rscript -e "cmdstanr::install_cmdstan()"

      - name: Build site
        run: |
            pkgdown::build_site_github_pages(
              lazy = FALSE,
              run_dont_run = TRUE,
              new_process = TRUE
            )
            # overwrite references/index.html so it points to all functions instead of addition terms page
            unlink("docs/reference/index.html")
            pkgdown::build_reference_index(
              override = list(destination = "docs")
            )
        shell: Rscript {0}

      - name: Deploy to GitHub pages 🚀
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          clean: false 
          branch: gh-pages
          folder: docs
